assets.name: ThemeCastle
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed portrait iPhone background for a friendly party word game, 1024x1536. Create a polished playful illustrated fantasy castle world: a winding stone bridge leading to a grand storybook castle with many towers, banners, distant mountains and a small dragon silhouette high in the sky. Warm sunset, lavender sky and deep indigo foreground, painterly shapes and rich layered depth, tasteful all-ages adventure illustration. Castle focal point in upper third; foreground details along bottom and edges; calm middle area for opaque game UI panels. No text, letters, logos, UI, frames, watermarks, or characters close to camera. Artwork only, edge to edge.

assets.name: ThemeCity
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: full-bleed portrait iPhone background, 1024x1536, for City Lights theme in a party word game. A playful illustrated MODERN metropolis at blue hour, towering contemporary glass skyscrapers and art-deco high rises glowing with office windows in the upper third, elevated subway train, yellow taxis far down a broad avenue, a small urban pocket park and fire escape at the lower edges. Painterly polished game artwork, layered depth, cobalt blue and warm amber. Street-level perspective looking up the avenue. Calm lower-middle space for opaque UI panels. Clearly contemporary urban city. NO castles, cathedrals, medieval buildings, fantasy palaces, European villages, text, signage, logos, watermarks or UI. Edge to edge artwork only.
